visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit modern bedroom. A woman in a black cropped top and lavender-patterned jeans playfully wrestles on a large bed with a man in a white t-shirt and khaki shorts. The lighting is warm and bright. (2) The couple sits on the edge of the bed; the woman holds a black drawstring bag with 'LEMUSÉE' printed in white. She gestures enthusiastically towards the camera while the man holds a small printed card. (3) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the couple unfolding a large, creamy-beige bedsheet and tucking it into the corners of the mattress. They collaborate, moving around the bed with energetic movements. (4) They transition to fitting a duvet into a matching cream cover. The woman crawls across the bed to smooth out wrinkles. (5) The woman displays a custom blue pillowcase featuring anime characters. Finally, the couple lies down on the freshly made bed, smiling. Close-up shots highlight the smooth, silky texture of the fabric under warm lighting.
